models.preferred_precision: official Diffusers checkpoint dtype; prefer MPS bfloat16 when available, MPS float32 otherwise, and CPU float32 as final fallback because fp16 can overflow the transformer residual stream
models.notes: Public `acestep` catalog entry. Uses Diffusers AceStepPipeline with Hugging Face checkpoint files, not an external ACE-Step source tree or package. On Apple MPS, fp16 can overflow during transformer denoising; AbstractMusic prefers MPS bfloat16 when supported, then MPS float32, and only falls back to CPU float32 if MPS still fails. A 30-second CPU seed-123 smoke passed harmonic-diversity and spectrotemporal artifact gates against the accepted reference floor. Other trained AceStepPipeline-compatible checkpoints may work when selected explicitly, but they are not surfaced in discovery until they are reviewed.

models.notes: Official ACE-Step v1.5 XL supervised fine-tuned checkpoint in the Diffusers repository layout, loadable through AceStepPipeline. Not guidance-distilled: AbstractMusic applies the model card's num_inference_steps=50, guidance_scale=7.0, shift=3.0 by default for non-turbo variants. Validation record (MPS bfloat16, raw short prompts): 2 of 5 distinct 30-second generations passed all quality gates, and maintainer listening confirmed one raw-prompt generation as good and the post-fix arcade regeneration as music; 3 runs missed one floor entropy ratio (backlog 0088). At 60 seconds the full-bundle, compact, and raw caption configurations all passed the automated gate set, but the full-bundle control failed maintainer listening review with a double-time opening the gates do not measure (backlog 0090). Marked caption_sensitive: long template captions reliably degraded 30-second output, sometimes to unpitched noise-sweep collapse (bpm/keyscale/timesignature conditioning isolated as harmless), so feature captions render compactly and the noise-texture screen flags the collapse signature. Kept unrecommended pending broader validation.
